|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[One-Arm (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys to any marker site. All wampas are selective creatures. All other wampas are ferocity and defense value + 2. Once per game, ▼ Wampa Cave.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to a marker site. Wampas are [Presence]. Other wampas are ferocity and defense value +2. Once per game, may deploy Wampa Cave from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' added “only”; “any” → “a”; “All wampas” → “Wampas”; “selective creatures. All other” → “[Presence]. Other”; “+ 2.” → “+2.”; “▼” → “may deploy”; “Cave.” → “Cave from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 42. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[One-Arm]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[One-Arm (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[One-Arm]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_42.
